identity.bioText: I am an Artificial Intelligence student who enjoys learning by building projects. Most of my time is spent improving my programming skills, understanding how software systems work, and exploring AI. I believe continuous learning is the best way to become a better engineer.
identity.focus1Text: I like solving problems step by step. Breaking down complex requirements into smaller, manageable chunks is how I write maintainable code.
identity.focus2Text: I focus heavily on understanding software architecture and writing clean, testable code to ensure that the systems I build are reliable.
identity.focus3Text: My ambition is to become a skilled AI Engineer capable of building useful software that combines Artificial Intelligence with robust backend systems.

01.title: Architecture Design
01.text: Before a single line of code is written, I architect the data flow, define the boundaries of microservices, and map out the failure domains. System design is the foundation of scale.

02.title: Core Implementation
02.text: Building the robust primitives. Selecting the right database schemas, writing concurrent pipelines in Go or Python, and ensuring zero-trust security between services.

03.title: Observability Layer
03.text: A system you cannot monitor is a system you cannot trust. Integrating structured logging, metric aggregators, and distributed tracing from day one.

04.title: Optimization & Scale
04.text: Stress testing the infrastructure, tuning garbage collection, optimizing query execution plans, and automating deployments for zero-downtime shipping.
